يتشخبط (form IIq)
# يَتَشَخْبَطُ (yatašaḵbaṭu) /ja.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# يُتَشَخْبَطُ (yutašaḵbaṭu) /ju.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# يَتَشَخْبَطَ (yatašaḵbaṭa) /ja.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of ت
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
